prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone transparent fantasy equipment sprite for the painterly Kalistar card game. Create ONE exquisite unique weapon, Hache du Roi Déchu, a fallen dwarven king's carefully hand-forged battle axe. Detailed narrative fantasy painting with visible confident brushwork, painted metal planes, hierarchically crisp silhouette, physically credible construction; NOT photography, NOT smooth 3D, NOT a flat pictogram. Single broad bearded crescent axe blade in weathered dark steel with a bright honed silver cutting edge, restrained aged gold and burnished copper inlay, a subtly broken crown relief on the axe head expressing lost royalty, strong compact haft of dark wood with worn leather grip and a finely worked copper pommel. A few believable nicks, well-loved not rusty junk. Beautiful substantial silhouette, grounded regal craftsmanship rather than enormous spikes. Readable highlight planes and copper warmth against cool steel. Full complete axe alone, diagonal from lower left pommel to upper right head, centered in a square 1024x1024 canvas, largest extent roughly 76 percent of canvas, generous transparent margins, no part cropped. Optimized for small circular medallion display: strong readable head and shaft, keep all significant artwork within a centered circular safe area of diameter 84 percent of the canvas. Genuine transparent alpha background. No card, no medallion circle, no UI, no bonus plaque, no text, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no scene, no person, no ground shadow, no full-canvas glow. Make it feel like a unique physical relic from a serious painterly fantasy game.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone transparent fantasy equipment sprite for Kalistar, paired stylistically with a carefully painted worn steel and copper royal axe. Create ONE beautiful unique magical TRANSVERSE FLUTE named La Flûte des Petits Bonheurs, the cherished instrument of Momo, a kind scrap-built robot musician. It must clearly be a real silver transverse concert flute: long straight slim metal tube, side-facing embouchure plate near the headjoint, many recognizable round silver keys and rods along the body, articulated footjoint, closed head end and open foot end; no guitar, no recorder, no vertical mouthpiece, no reed. Exquisite but humble craftsmanship, luminous silver surfaces with softly aged brass collars and a few delicate gold repairs, gently engraved flowing motifs, a tiny warm amber inset at one joint. Tender supportive magic rather than an offensive weapon: a fine pale electric-blue thread following a short portion of the tube, a few restrained golden pinpricks hugging the instrument, faint light in several key cups. No large aura. Detailed narrative fantasy painting, visible controlled brushwork, convincing painted metal planes, selective bright highlights and softly worn edges, not photography, not plastic 3D, not anime, not a flat icon. Full entire flute diagonally from lower left foot to upper right head, centered with generous empty transparent margins; keep the single flute and all small magical details fully within the centered circular safe area of diameter 84 percent of a square 1024x1024 canvas. The flute's length about 76 percent of the canvas diagonal and its tube/keys intentionally substantial enough to read in a small medallion. Genuine transparent alpha background, clean edge. No hands, no person, no scene, no ground shadow, no case, no circle or medallion, no UI, no plaque, no text, no numbers, no musical-note glyphs, no logo, no watermark. Show the gentle personality of a lovingly kept object that makes broken things a little happier.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this exact Kalistar transverse flute sprite. Preserve the complete flute's silhouette, diagonal placement, silver and aged gold materials, recognizable keywork, embouchure, tiny amber inset, painterly craftsmanship and fully transparent alpha background. Add just a LITTLE more visible ELECTRIC INCANDESCENCE AROUND the flute: several delicately branching blue-white electrical filaments gently curling around and alongside the body, a soft pale cyan glow very close to the metal, and a few tiny warm gold spark points. The electric arcs must be visible outside the flute silhouette as well as softly reflecting on the silver, with graceful restrained movement suggested, like a supportive magical instrument quietly awakening. Thin luminous arcs rather than thick lightning, no explosion, no fire, no big circular aura, no lightning filling the canvas, no extra object. Keep the instrument crisp and more visually important than the effects, generous transparent margins, no cropping, no text, no logo, no card, no medallion border. This is a tender magic support weapon, not an attack spell. Preserve actual transparent background.
